entities.name: Table T1 – Equity Inflows Hedge Funds Rolling Four-Week Net Equity Flows
entities.brief: Rolling 4-week average net equity flows for Hedge Funds
entities.description: Shows significant volatility in hedge fund net flows, with peaks and troughs highlighting dynamic positioning

properties.table_content:
| Year | Hedge Funds Net Buys ($ mn, 4-wk avg. range) | Notes |
|------|---------------------------------------------|-------|
| 2008 | ($1,200) to $200                            | Significant outflows, especially late year. |
| 2009 | ($700) to $1,400                            | Strong buying in Q1, then large swings. |
| 2010 | ($500) to $500                              | More balanced flows, smaller magnitude. |
| 2011 | ($400) to $300                              | Generally subdued activity. |
| 2012 | ($400) to $500                              | Modest net buying periods. |
| 2013 | ($500) to $500                              | Volatile, with both buys and sells. |
| 2014 | ($300) to $600                              | Mostly net buying. |
| 2015 | ($500) to $600                              | Mixed flows, some periods of strong buying. |
| 2016 | ($600) to $600                              | Increased volatility, notable outflows. |
| 2017 | ($300) to $500                              | Generally positive, some outflows. |
| 2018 | ($300) to $400                              | Relatively contained flows. |
| 2019 | ($200) to $500                              | Mostly net buying. |
| 2020 | ($1,000) to $800                            | Sharp rebound in buying after deep early outflows. |
| 2021 | ($800) to $800                              | Highly volatile, significant swings. |
| 2022 | ($1,500) to $1,200                          | Extreme volatility, large outflows and peak inflows. |
| 2023 | ($1,000) to $1,200                          | Strong inflows early year, persistent outflows later. |
| 2024 | ($1,500) to $500                            | Dominant outflows, especially mid-year. |
| 2025 | ($1,200) to $200                            | Continued net selling into current period. |
| Last 3 weeks | Outflows | Rolling 4-wk avg. shows continued net selling. |
properties.key_insight: Hedge Funds experienced significant volatility with peaks in Q1 2009 (~$1,400mn) and troughs in late 2008, late 2022, and mid-2024.
